name: Slack
recent_news: Slack announced it is exploring strategic alternatives after receiving acquisition interest. Salesforce is rumored to be in advanced talks to acquire the workplace messaging app for over $20 billion.
description: Slack is an enterprise messaging and team collaboration platform.
realized_deal: Acquired by Salesforce ($27.7B in Dec 2020 / July 2021)

name: Segment
recent_news: Customer data platform Segment is reportedly in late-stage acquisition talks with Twilio. The strategic buyout is expected to be valued at $3.2 billion.
description: Segment is a customer data platform that helps businesses collect, clean, and activate customer data.

name: Plaid
recent_news: Visa announced a definitive agreement to acquire fintech infrastructure startup Plaid for $5.3 billion to expand its reach in digital payments.
description: Plaid is a financial technology company that connects consumer bank accounts to apps.

name: Mailchimp
recent_news: Intuit is nearing a deal to acquire email marketing company Mailchimp for $12 billion, marking a massive exit for the bootstrapped software firm.
description: Mailchimp is an email marketing and marketing automation platform for small and medium businesses.

name: Giphy
recent_news: Facebook has officially agreed to acquire Giphy for $400 million and plans to integrate the GIF library deeply into Instagram.
description: Giphy is an online database and search engine that allows users to share short looping videos and GIFs.

name: Auth0
recent_news: Okta is in advanced discussions to acquire identity management provider Auth0 in a major stock transaction valued at approximately $6.5 billion.
description: Auth0 provides an authentication and authorization platform for application developers.

name: Nuance Communications
recent_news: Microsoft is in advanced talks to acquire conversational AI and speech recognition leader Nuance Communications for nearly $20 billion.
description: Nuance provides conversational AI and clinical speech recognition solutions for healthcare providers.

name: Fitbit
recent_news: Google confirmed regulatory milestones for its $2.1 billion acquisition of fitness tracking pioneer Fitbit to bolster its wearables business.
description: Fitbit produces consumer wearable activity trackers and health measurement devices.

name: Sumo Logic
recent_news: Cloud analytics and log management software firm Sumo Logic is exploring strategic options and inbound buyout offers from private equity firms.
description: Sumo Logic provides cloud-based machine data analytics and SIEM solutions.

name: Proofpoint
recent_news: Thoma Bravo reached an agreement to acquire enterprise cybersecurity and email protection firm Proofpoint in an all-cash transaction valued at $12.3 billion.
description: Proofpoint provides cybersecurity solutions for email security, data loss prevention, and cloud threat defense.
realized_deal: PE Buyout by Thoma Bravo ($12.3B in April 2021)

name: RealPage
recent_news: Thoma Bravo entered a definitive agreement to acquire real estate software maker RealPage for approximately $10.2 billion.
description: RealPage provides property management software and data analytics for real estate owners and managers.
realized_deal: PE Buyout by Thoma Bravo ($10.2B in Dec 2020)

name: Cloudera
recent_news: Private equity firms KKR and Clayton Dubilier & Rice have reached a deal to take enterprise data cloud company Cloudera private for $5.3 billion.
description: Cloudera provides hybrid enterprise data cloud platforms for machine learning and analytics.
realized_deal: PE Buyout by KKR & CD&R ($5.3B in June 2021)

name: Medallia
recent_news: Customer and employee experience platform Medallia agreed to be acquired by private equity firm Thoma Bravo in an all-cash $6.4 billion transaction.
description: Medallia is a customer experience management SaaS platform used by major global brands.
realized_deal: PE Buyout by Thoma Bravo ($6.4B in July 2021)

name: Cornerstone OnDemand
recent_news: Clearlake Capital reached a definitive agreement to acquire talent management and HR software company Cornerstone OnDemand for $5.2 billion.
description: Cornerstone OnDemand provides talent management, recruiting, and learning SaaS software.
realized_deal: PE Buyout by Clearlake Capital ($5.2B in Aug 2021)

name: McAfee Enterprise
recent_news: An investor consortium led by Advent International and Permira agreed to acquire cybersecurity provider McAfee in a take-private deal valued over $14 billion.
description: McAfee provides consumer and enterprise cybersecurity, antivirus, and threat protection software.
realized_deal: PE Buyout by Advent & Permira ($14.0B in Nov 2021)

name: Stripe
recent_news: Stripe raised $600 million in an extension to its Series G round at a $36 billion valuation. The founders state they are focused on long-term infrastructure and have no plans to sell.
description: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for online commerce and billing.
realized_deal: Remained Independent Private Company ($36B Series G)

name: Discord
recent_news: Discord valuation doubled to $7 billion following a new $100M funding round. The company is investing in community moderation tools and exploring an independent future.
description: Discord is a voice, video, and text communication platform for communities.
realized_deal: Remained Independent Private Company ($7B Series H)

name: SpaceX
recent_news: SpaceX secured $1.9 billion in new venture funding. Elon Musk reiterates the company will remain private to prioritize Starship and Mars colonization.
description: SpaceX designs, manufactures, and launches reusable orbital space rockets.

name: Robinhood
recent_news: Robinhood valuation jumped to $11.2 billion after raising $200M as retail trading volumes set records during the market volatility.
description: Robinhood provides commission-free stock and options trading for retail investors.

name: Epic Games
recent_news: Sony invested $250 million for a minority stake in Fortnite maker Epic Games. Epic continues to operate independently under founder control.
description: Epic Games develops interactive entertainment software and the Unreal Engine platform.

name: Snowflake
recent_news: Snowflake filed for its massive initial public offering, debuting as the largest software IPO in history with strong revenue growth.
description: Snowflake is a cloud data warehousing and analytics company.

name: GitLab
recent_news: GitLab expanded its all-remote engineering team and prepared its DevSecOps platform for a planned future public listing.
description: GitLab is an open-core DevOps lifecycle management platform.

name: Databricks
recent_news: Databricks announced the acquisition of Redash and continued rapid expansion of its unified data analytics platform across AWS and Azure.
description: Databricks provides cloud data engineering and machine learning platforms based on Apache Spark.
realized_deal: Remained Independent Private Company ($1B Series G in 2021)

name: Figma
recent_news: Figma raised $50 million at a $2 billion valuation as remote work accelerated adoption of its collaborative design tool.
description: Figma is a collaborative cloud-based interface design tool.

name: Notion
recent_news: Notion raised $50 million at a $2 billion valuation from Index Ventures to expand its all-in-one workspace platform.
description: Notion is an all-in-one workspace application for notes, tasks, wikis, and databases.

name: Canva
recent_news: Canva raised $60 million at a $6 billion valuation as its visual design platform crossed 30 million monthly active users.
description: Canva is an online graphic design platform used globally.

name: Chime
recent_news: Chime raised $485 million in Series F funding at a $14.5 billion valuation, making it the most valuable US consumer fintech startup.
description: Chime is a mobile digital bank offering fee-free checking accounts and debit cards.

name: Klarna
recent_news: Klarna raised $650 million at a $10.6 billion valuation to fuel US expansion for its buy-now-pay-later shopping service.
description: Klarna provides buy-now-pay-later payment services for online merchants.
realized_deal: Remained Independent Private Company ($31B raise in 2021)

name: Revolut
recent_news: Revolut raised $500 million in Series D funding at a $5.5 billion valuation to expand its European digital banking services.
description: Revolut is a European digital bank and financial super-app.
realized_deal: Remained Independent Private Company ($33B raise in 2021)

name: Airtable
recent_news: Airtable raised $185 million at a $2.58 billion valuation and introduced low-code development tools for enterprise teams.
description: Airtable is a cloud-based low-code platform combining spreadsheets and relational databases.
